_comment: Above: Zerodha's hosted Kite MCP server (github.com/zerodha/kite-mcp-server). It is read-mostly:
holdings, positions, orders, margins, quotes. It leaves out order placement. You log in to Kite
in your browser when it asks; no keys go in this file or in the chat.
To place orders, self-host the same server with your own Kite Connect app instead: move the
block below into mcpServers in place of the hosted one. The variable names and how to start the
server are placeholders: check them against the kite-mcp-server README before you use them.
Type your key and secret into this file only, never into the chat.
